chapters.title: Glück
chapters.summary:
Macht attacks the carriage of a nobleman heading towards the Fortress City of Weise and kills all of the noble's guards. This nobleman is Glück, the feudal lord of Weise. With the demon's blade by his neck, Glück fearlessly requests to smoke one last cigarette, which intrigues Macht and they converse.
Macht tells Glück about his quest to understand foreign emotions. When he learns of the demon's preoccupation, Glück details the history of his life. He is the ruler of the Fortress City of Weise, which has long been plagued with corruption. Yet he did not take any action against the corruption and the suffering of the people until his son was murdered by the other nobles in Weise for publicly pleading for them to improve the city. Because of his son's death, Glück became determined to change Weise for the better, resorting to multiple assassinations of the corrupted nobles in power. When Macht questions the reason he is retelling this, Glück reveals that he is negotiating with the demon. Glück will teach Macht the emotions he does not understand, but only on a condition. Macht must assassinate the allies of the nobles who are in power and help him gain control of Weise. Macht accepts the condition and proceeds to eliminate all of Glück's political opponents.

chapters.title: Onstage
chapters.summary:
Shortly after the defeat of the Demon King, Glück and Macht discuss the work the demon needs to do for him on the front stage, which is gaining the goodwill of the nobles of Weise. Glück also explains to him how he intends to teach Macht about "justice" and "evil" in exchange for using his power for his ends. Under this contract, Macht is introduced to the citizens of Weise officially as the Mage of the Glück family. In the following years, he socializes with the nobility of Weise and manages to integrate into the city. The nobles still intend to test his loyalty by asking him to defeat a remnant of the Demon King Army headed towards the Fortress City of Weise. Having no sense of loyalty, Macht effortlessly dispatches the demons, gaining the trust of the nobility and citizens of Weise.
When Macht volunteers to become an instructor of magic, Glück was at first skeptical but decides to accede to the demon's request. He introduces Macht to a child of his relative, Denken, whose parents were killed by demons, and commands Macht to teach him magic. Macht obliges, introducing himself to Denken afterwards as the magic instructor of the Gluck family. Despite expressing his distrust of the demon, Denken agrees to become his apprentice.

chapters.title: The End of Weise
chapters.summary:
Macht begins instructing Denken on how to use magic, which the latter had enjoyed. Under Glück's order, Macht continues to mentor the boy in magic, as an instructor and the eventual enemy to be defeated. Through the years studying from Macht, Denken becomes a successful military mage, and secures marriage to Glück's daughter, Lektüre, who is also his childhood sweetheart. 
At around this time, due to the destruction of a northern Fortress City at the hands of a powerful demon, the townspeople become restless and demand that Macht be put under the Stone Bracelet of Servitude as a safety mechanism to control him. Macht agrees to the terms and is equipped with the mind-controlling bracelet. He continues to serve Glück many years afterwards and oversees his daughter's death and his son-in-law's departure from his hometown without any return in sight. As Glück has grown old, Macht finally decides to destroy the Fortress City of Weise, carrying out his original plan to attempt to feel malice or guilt.

chapters.title: The Great Barrier
chapters.summary:
A dejected Macht sits inside the destroyed Fortress City of Weise and laments his failure to feel new emotions. Before he can proceed to leave the city, however, Serie appears behind him and demands he return the city back to normal or be killed. It turns out that Macht cannot return the city back to normal, which Serie takes note of and concludes it is because Macht is a monster who cannot understand humankind and thus cannot construct a visualization of himself returning people back from gold. Enraged at her provocation, Macht attempts to use his magic on her, but it is reflected back onto his own body, making the demon take a step back. 
When asked about her identity, Serie introduces herself as a Great Mage who has lived for so long that even the demons have forgotten the fear she brought. Macht, realizing that the enemy is different than everyone else he has fought, dispells the curse applied on himself and engages in battle. They fight for a while, where Serie effectively neutralizes all of Macht's attacks, taunting the demon in the meantime to his chagrin. In the midst of their confrontation, Lernen and another first-class mage intervene, temporarily containing Macht in a magic prison. Lernen appeals to Serie to leave the demon alive until they can find a method to return Weise back to normal. He proposes that the first-class mages will seal Macht inside a barrier until a solution can be found, and Serie accedes to his proposal after he persists in asking her, and Macht is thus sealed inside the Fortress City of Weise.
Macht's memories conclude as Frieren and Denken finish the initial analysis of his memories. Frieren continues to analyze the memories in more depth. Due to the process taking up too much of her mana, Frieren cannot move afterwards and relies on Fern for help. At the same time, Solitär shows up at the Great Barrier of the Golden Land and begins to break it down.

chapters.summary:
Right after the events of the previous chapter, Fern shares with the rest information about the mana she had briefly detected. Denken is skeptical of its accuracy due to the effect of the Golden Land, but shows caution and proposes they stay vigilant. They discuss the detailed analysis of Macht's memories which Frieren is carrying out and predicts that it will take two months to complete. Since the keeper's house does not have a bed, they decide to move and stay at the nearest settlement until the analysis is concluded.
At the meantime, Macht appears at the edge of the Great Barrier to meet Solitär, who has come and is deciphering the Great Barrier of the Golden Land. Solitär makes conversation with Macht, even though the latter cannot hear her voice, telling him to be wary of Frieren and that she is one of the few people capable of defeating him. She tells Macht that she has come to witness the conclusion of his experiment to coexist with humans and will assist him by breaking the Great Barrier of the Golden Land, informing him that the process will take roughly two months. She finishes the analysis and breaks down the Great Barrier at the end, right before Frieren is able to finish her analysis of Macht's memories.

chapters.title: Nameless Greater Demon
chapters.summary: After the barrier is broken in the previous chapter, Fern senses a demon with mana as powerful as that of Macht. That demon, Solitär, approaches an indifferent Macht and offers to assist him with his experiment. Denken decides to evacuate the people in the settlement, including Frieren, who is still asleep analyzing the memories of Macht, while Fern and Stark stay behind to hold the demon back. When Solitär encounters them, she introduces herself as a Greater Demon, to which Fern expresses grave concern since Frieren has never told her about that name. As the two sides engage in combat, Solitär keeps asking questions to both Fern and Stark, who are greatly injured by her attacks.

chapters.title: Master and Apprentice
chapters.summary: After Stark and Fern stayed behind to confront Solitär, Denken also chooses to stay behind, urging the evacuating villagers to escort Frieren to the Empire for safety. Soon after, Denken confronts Macht, who reveals his intent to eliminate all who know of him, allowing him to start anew elsewhere. Determined to neutralize a threat to humanity, Denken resolves to stop him. Their battle mirrors their past training sessions, with Macht acknowledging Denken’s significant improvement in technique. As Macht attempts to end the fight with Diagoldze, he unexpectedly begins transmuting into gold due to Denken's Curse Reversal Magic, a spell granted by Serie. Knowing Macht can undo the transformation, Denken stays vigilant as Macht begins restoring himself, ready for the fight to resume.

chapters.title: Retribution
chapters.summary: After Denken is turned to gold, he is awoken by his wife, Lektüre, in a dream. Despite being convinced of his defeat, Lektüre reminds him that the Denken she knows has never given up in his many training fights against Macht. Denken is reminded of the one time he managed to injure Macht, before he is awoken by Frieren nullifying Diagoldze's effect on him. Denken and Frieren then go to confront Macht and Solitär. Frieren tells Macht that his plan for coexistence is doomed to fail, before telling him that it is time for retribution. However, Denken interrupts Frieren and asks that she leave the fight with Macht to him instead, leaving Frieren to fight against an exuberant Solitär.

chapters.title: Time for Retribution
chapters.summary:
Right after Denken fires a condensed Zoltraak spell at Macht, he collapses, and Macht leaves heavily injured, intending to regroup. While he walks through the alleyway, bleeding, he notices that Solitär is dead. Macht recalls his conversation with Solitär just a few hours prior. She had told him that no matter how eccentric his beliefs were, he was still a demon in the end. Macht begins to feel embarrassed that he still fears death, just like other demons. Macht had previously believed that he would accept death if he was able to feel the emotions he was looking for, but as his mana is flowing away, he is ashamed that he is attempting to flee. At this thought, Macht smiles, and wonders where he is exactly fleeing to, as he will not survive either way. 
Macht approaches Glück, who is still standing where he was turned into a statue before, and Macht kneels in front of him. The two smoke together, and Macht regrets that he was unable to understand the emotions he was looking for. Glück apologies for being unable to fulfill his promise to follow Macht to the depths of hell until Macht was successful. Denken appears, stumbling towards Macht, and Macht threatens to hold Glück hostage. Glück tells Macht that he is truly beyond help, and asks Denken to put Macht out of his misery. Denken fires a spell, killing Macht, and city guards rush over. Glück stands over Macht’s disappearing mana, calling him a friend, and stating that he enjoyed the time they spent together.

chapters.title: Reunion
chapters.summary: Fifty-three years before the death of Himmel the Hero, the Hero Party is in the Kino Pass. The Hero Party trek back from the monument to the main road, only to find a slain unit of imperial soldiers. They are suddenly accosted by Zart the Remnant, a demon who has sensed Frieren's space-time meddling. Himmel engages in battle with Zart, but he manages to slip behind the front lines and casts his teleportation spell on Fireren, sending her high into the sky in an era where she cannot use her flight magic freely.

chapters.title: Zart the Remnant
chapters.summary: Right after the events of the previous chapter, Frieren manages to land without using flight magic. With her support, the Hero Party back Zart against a cliff. Zart touches the cliff and teleports a chunk of mountain above the Hero Party, who all trust that Frieren is holding back a spell to get them out of their pinch. Frieren releases her mana and destroys the mountain, before using flight magic and Zoltraak to defeat Zart and revealing to her party that she is capable of feats beyond their era.

chapters.title: The Party of Heroes
chapters.summary: After Frieren defeats Zart, she tells the Hero Party that she is from the future. The party then decide to gather information to return Frieren to the future. They head to a town with the Mages' Guild and a Church but are unsuccessful in finding anything. Frieren apologizes for the trouble and is reminded that Himmel is a detour fanatic; they are hired by a merchant as bodyguards later that night while gathering information in the tavern.

chapters.title: Escort Mission
chapters.summary: The next day, the Hero Party escort a merchant to a nearby village. They are attacked by humanoid wolf monsters that use human tactics on the way, and the Hero Party all display their teamwork and the unique roles that they play in the team, such as Eisen with his monstrous durability. After escorting the merchant, they then continue onward in Kino Pass looking for information about the Monument of the Goddess.

chapters.title: Faith
chapters.summary: After escorting the merchant, the Hero Party continue seeking out information about the Monument of the Goddess. After another village proves to be a dead end, the party decides to try seeking out written records in a monastery. They travel to a monastery perched on a sheer drop-off. During one of rest stops, while Himmel and Eisen exclaim over the cliffs they are about to scale, Heiter tells Frieren about his and Himmel's shared childhood. Heiter tells Frieren that though he is a contrary person, he has decided to believe in Himmel the Hero. They then make it to the monastery, only for the monastery to be a dead end as well.

chapters.title: Abyssal Dragon
chapters.summary: After the monastery is a dead end, the Hero Party decide to focus on folktales and oral traditions from older settlements instead. The Hero Party then travel to another village where they learn from the barkeep of the ruins of a Unified Empire city that contain a cathedral. The party then defeat an Abyssal Dragon together in order to access the cathedral ruins.

chapters.title: The Sword of the Hero
chapters.summary: Right after the events of the previous chapter, after defeating the Abyssal Dragon, the Hero Party searches the abandoned village but finds no clues. They continue their search and arrive in a newly settled village, where a villager directs them to a dwarven blacksmith named Kiesel. Kiesel states that his old village used to have some books on the Goddess's Monuments, and he'll tell them the location if he can take a closer look at the Sword of the Hero. Himmel allows him to, and readily admits that the sword is fake. Kiesel reveals that he is te one who created this forgery. He thanks Himmel for bringing the sword's replica back to him and offers to give him a new sword worthy of the Hero free of charge, but Himmel tells him that the sword is now his partner in arms, and he will wield it until the world is at peace. Kiesel, seeing his determination, sharpens the sword instead. He then directs them to his old village, which has become a den of monsters.

chapters.title: Spell to Return
chapters.summary: Right after the events of the previous chapter, Frieren reads through the book discussing the Goddess's Monument, and figures out that the spell to return can be found in the "Time-Traveling Bird" chapter of the scripture, which no spells have ever been deciphered from. Eisen proposes waiting out the time, but Frieren says that she wishes to return to the present. Himmel declares that the rest of the Hero Party will decipher the spell after they defeat the Demon King, and carve it onto the Goddess's Monument for future Frieren to read. The party then begins to trek back to the monument so Frieren can cast the spell to return. Meanwhile, Solitär, Grausam, Rivale, and Tot gather by the monument and prepare to try to kill Frieren.

chapters.title: False Image of a Hero
chapters.summary: Thirty-one years after the Hero Himmel's passing, Frieren's Party are in Bohne Village. They have arrived at the village just in time for the Liberation Festival, which is celebrated in Imperial Territory on the anniversary of the Demon King's defeat every year. Frieren, Stark, and Fern decide to join in on the festivities. Frieren decides to go touch the statue of the Hero Himmel, as according to tradition doing so brings good luck, but the party discovers that the design of the statue of Himmel looks very different from all the others they have seen. While it doesn't sit right with Stark, Frieren tells him to leave it be as the villagers have faith in the false image of Himmel they have created and the statue wasn't created with malicious intent. Later, Frieren recalls how shortly after the Hero Party defeated the Demon King, embellished stories had already begun to spread, such as the story of a ten-meter serpent that the Hero Party killed becoming a one hundred meter serpent. Though Frieren was upset, Himmel reassures her that even if the exact story is forgotten, their feats will never change. In the present day, Frieren agrees with Himmel's previous words, as even though the story has changed people are still celebrating the world that Himmel saved. The next day, Frieren's Party depart and continue traveling north while Stark brings up the story of Himmel cutting a thousand-meter serpent in half that he heard in town.

chapters.title: The Titan Fortress Ruins
chapters.summary: Thirty-one years after the death of the Hero Himmel, Frieren's Party come across the Titan Fortress Ruins. Frieren tells them that the ruler of the lands around the fortress was once the Armée family, a warrior family unlike a typical noble family. In times of conflict, nobles did not need grace, as military might was enough to give them authority, but it seems the Armée family has not been able to withstand time's flow. They then come across Count Armée, who is wrestling with monsters in the wilderness. He asks them to help him recover the hidden treasures in a secret chamber under the fortress and offers the spell to keep your body nice and warm as a reward. They then fight through the hordes of monsters that have taken over the fortress. They encounter a particularly strong monster, and Count Armée tells the party to flee and not risk their lives over a trivial spell, but Frieren tells him that it isn't trivial to her. In a flashback, Frieren asks an old Flamme why humans bother to study magic. Flamme tells her that though she may not be able to reach the pinnacle of magic, she will leave a gift for the world - more spells than Frieren could ever learn, even if she spent her whole life trying. After defeating the monster, Frieren tests the spell on Stark. The party then continue their travels.

chapters.title: Proof of Perseverance
chapters.summary: Thirty-one years after the death of the Hero Himmel, Frieren's Party stop in a town in the Hören Region. It is Stark's birthday. Stark leaves to get his axe sharpened, and Fern follows, hoping to catch him alone to give him his present. However, it takes her the better part of the day, as Stark spends the day opening up villagers' hearts and helping others. Fern is finally able to give Stark his gift, a pair of new leather gloves, late in the evening. Stark wonders if he looked shabby in his worn out pair, but Fern states that it is a proof of his perseverance and all the effort he has put in so far. Stark recalls telling Eisen the same, that his mantle was evidence of his master's efforts, and in the present day resolves to train even harder. Fern tells him he already works hard enough, and the pair return to the inn where Frieren has made Stark hamburger steaks.

chapters.title: Shadow Warrior
chapters.summary: Thirty-one years after the death of the Hero Himmel, Frieren's Party trek through a mountain pass to reach a village in the Aufgabe Federation. They are informed that not many adventurers have stopped in the village since the big main road to the Imperial Capital was built thirty years ago. The mayor of the village, an elderly and beloved man by the name of Radaal, welcomes them to the village and asks them to share stories of their adventures with the other villagers. Frieren shakes his hand and begins to feel suspicious, as he has the hands of a warrior in active service. Meanwhile, Frieren's Party share stories with the village while Radaal helps with small tasks around the village. Radaal sits down with his wife later and she tells him he missed out on hearing the adventurers' stories. They briefly reminisce about their lives together, before Radaal says something uncharacteristically kind. She asks him what's wrong, but he tells her it's nothing and he has one more task he needs to complete. That night, Frieren asks Stark to take first watch outside their accommodations. She explains why Radaal makes her feel uneasy, despite the kind things the villagers have said about him. Radaal recalls his top secret mission, given to him when he was young, to kill everyone on a list before they can reach the Imperial Capital. The mission only ends once everyone on the list is dead. Frieren is the last of the list. Radaal then approaches the cabin the party are staying at, where he confronts Stark outside. Though Stark attempts to talk Radaal down, he knocks Stark out with a single blow and prepares to head inside to kill Frieren.

chapters.title: Beneath the Water's Surface
chapters.summary: Kanone, the vice-captain of the Magic Special Forces, brings Glück in for questioning. She attempts to convince Glück to state that he was deceived by Macht in order to reduce the severity of his sentence, but Glück maintains that he and Macht were partners. Glück discerns that Kanone's captain must be Fräse, and he recalls that Fräse was the mage that Macht warned him was strong enough to destroy Weise on her own. Glück then leaves, and Kanone speaks with Denken after, who expresses surprise at Glück's light punishment. He asks about the mission of the Magic Special Forces, but Kanone is unable to tell him the details. They are interrupted by the arrival of Neu, who reports that Land and Übel have been captured. Elsewhere in Eiseberg, Frieren wakes up early on her own, which Stark takes to be a harbinger of catastrophe.

chapters.title: Silver Coins
chapters.summary: The Shadow Warriors gather and discuss the mission that Löwe has assigned them, and Clematis assigns everyone roles in the mission. The Shadow Warriors discuss their opponents and the probability of the assassination succeeding. Schritt reveals that Löwe is rumored to have previously killed a Great Mage, Minus, making it possible for him to visualize the death of the Great Mage Serie. After, the warriors split up in pairs at Wolf's insistence. Iris and Routine take a secret underground passageway into the castle and discuss their mission, but they are overheard by Falsch. Gazelle is seen having a drink at Wolf's bar, where he repays his tab using the silver coins Frieren previously paid him with. He comments that he wanted to pay Wolf back before he died. Meanwhile, while Frieren's Party head back to Gazelle's stall, Frieren tells Fern and Stark that she recognized Gazelle as a warrior, alongside the previous hero, Rasen, who is now masquerading as the vagabond Wehrlos. She reveals that she planned all along to track Gazelle by putting mana on the silver coins she paid him with, though Fern and Stark point out that Frieren was actually upset about being scammed.

In the meantime, Lore begins to track Frieren using the Goddess's Magic. Wolf, with her guidance, shoots at Frieren from afar, though Stark manages to take the shot for her. Sein detects Frieren's mana signal and leaves Wehrlos to seek the party out, just as Stark collapses from the poison.
